articles.title: Maharashtra New Industrial Policy 2026 announced, MSME loans up to 5 lakh...
articles.summary: Government targets 10 lakh new jobs with focus on green manufacturing. Single-window clearance and land allocation incentives expanded across Tier-2 cities.
articles.fullContent: The state cabinet unveiled the comprehensive Maharashtra New Industrial Policy 2026, offering collateral-free low-interest capital loans up to ₹5 lakh for new micro-enterprises and women-led rural industries. The policy introduces single-day industrial approvals through the Maitri 2.0 digital portal.
articles.author: Rajesh Gaikwad

articles.title: Farm loan waiver phase 2 begins, 12 lakh farmers to benefit from Oct 1
articles.summary: Rs 10,000 crore allocation announced for drought-affected districts. Online portal launched for direct benefit transfer into farmer accounts without paperwork.
articles.fullContent: Addressing a press conference at Mantralaya, the Agriculture Minister announced the rollout of Phase 2 of the agrarian debt relief framework. Over 12 lakh eligible agricultural landholders across Marathwada, Vidarbha, and North Maharashtra will receive direct settlement credits into verified bank accounts.
articles.author: Vilas Jadhav

articles.title: Mumbai-Pune Expressway speed limit raised to 120 kmph, new rules effective...
articles.summary: Lane discipline and automated challans for violations implemented. Advanced highway monitoring system with 180 camera points deployed across the ghat section.
articles.fullContent: The Maharashtra State Road Development Corporation (MSRDC) has officially revised the maximum permissible speed on straight stretches of the Yashwantrao Chavan Mumbai-Pune Expressway to 120 kmph for light motor vehicles.
articles.author: Sanjay Pawar

articles.title: Nashik grape exports surge 40%, European demand boosts farmer income
articles.summary: Record 2.5 lakh tonne shipment to UK and Netherlands this season. Cold chain infrastructure upgrades help Nashik farmers fetch record prices per container.
articles.fullContent: Nashik's grape growers celebrate an unprecedented export cycle with overseas dispatches surging by 40% over the previous fiscal year. Improved cold-chain logistics hubs and APEDA residue monitoring labs in Dindori and Niphad have enabled direct refrigerated ocean container shipments.
articles.author: Mahesh Bhamare

articles.title: Konkan tourism boom: New cruise service Mumbai-Goa launches
articles.summary: Luxury overnight cruise offers coastal stops at Alibaug and Ratnagiri. Service expected to attract 5 lakh tourists along Maharashtra's pristine coastline.
articles.fullContent: Coastal tourism received a massive stimulus today with the maiden voyage of the Konkan Voyager coastal passenger liner. Departing from Mumbai International Cruise Terminal, the ship navigates scenic Konkan waters with scheduled stopovers.
articles.author: Pooja Sawant

articles.title: Pune Metro: Hinjewadi-Shivajinagar line inaugurated, cuts travel to 15 mins
articles.summary: New IT corridor connectivity reduces commute time drastically. Daily ridership expected to cross 2 lakh with integrated multi-modal transit at key junction stations.
articles.fullContent: The eagerly awaited Hinjewadi to Shivajinagar elevated Metro Line 3 commenced official commercial operations today. Spanning 23 kilometers with 23 state-of-the-art stations, the new rapid transit system bypasses chronic traffic chokepoints along Baner, Wakad, and Pashan. Commuters reported completing the journey in under 18 minutes compared to the typical 90-minute road commute during peak hours.
articles.author: Prashant Patil

articles.title: IT Park to create 5000 jobs in Hinjewadi Phase-3, major hiring drive
articles.summary: Leading tech firms announce campus recruitment. Phase-3 expansion includes AI labs and fintech zones targeting skilled engineers and fresh graduates across Maharashtra.
articles.fullContent: The Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation (MIDC) and Hinjewadi Industries Association announced the completion of Phase-3 IT infrastructure development. Four premier tech multinational corporations and six burgeoning AI unicorns are launching dedicated engineering centers, generating an estimated 5,000 direct technical positions.
articles.author: Snehal Joshi

articles.title: Ganeshotsav 2026: Pune gears up with 2000+ mandals, AI security deployed
articles.summary: City implements smart surveillance and crowd management for biggest festival. Drone monitoring and automated heat-mapping activated across Laxmi Road and historic core.
articles.fullContent: With Ganeshotsav 2026 commencing this week, Pune City Police and the Municipal Corporation have rolled out the country's most advanced smart-crowd management grid. Over 1,200 high-definition AI-enabled cameras have been positioned at key junction points, tracking real-time pedestrian density.
articles.author: Omkar Deshmukh

articles.title: Savitribai Phule Pune University launches AI & Data Science degree
articles.summary: New 4-year program partners with tech giants for industry curriculum. Focus on generative AI, MLOps and real-world industrial research projects.
articles.fullContent: Savitribai Phule Pune University (SPPU) announced its cutting-edge B.Tech and M.Tech curriculum in Applied Artificial Intelligence and High-Performance Data Science. Designed in consultation with Pune's tech corridor leaders, the degree incorporates 12 months of mandatory industry residency.
articles.author: Kavita Kulkarni

articles.title: New 500-bed super-specialty hospital opens in Hadapsar
articles.summary: State-of-the-art facility offers robotic surgery and cancer care. Hospital equipped with AI diagnostics and dedicated emergency cardiac trauma unit.
articles.fullContent: Pune's eastern growth corridor received a major medical boost with the inauguration of a 500-bed multi-specialty healthcare complex in Hadapsar. Featuring next-generation robotic surgery suites, linear accelerator cancer radiotherapy, and a dedicated 50-bed pediatric ICU.
articles.author: Dr. Aniket Shinde

articles.title: Digital India completes 10 years: Rural digital connectivity reaches 98%
articles.summary: Over 600,000 villages connected via optical fiber network. UPI and DigiLocker usage sees 300% growth across tier-3 towns and rural panchayats.
articles.fullContent: Celebrating a decade of Digital India, national telecom authorities confirmed high-speed optical fiber connectivity has been operationalized across 98% of gram panchayats.
articles.author: Rohan Verma

articles.title: ISRO reveals Chandrayaan-4 sample return mission flight plan
articles.summary: Lunar sample return scheduled with dual-launch docking architecture and indigenous rover targeting the Moon's South Pole.
articles.fullContent: ISRO released the official mission architecture for Chandrayaan-4, representing India's boldest deep-space endeavor to date. The mission involves two LVM3 rocket launches.
articles.author: Devendra Rao

articles.title: NEP 2026: 10,000 schools modernized with AI labs and robotics curriculum
articles.summary: National Education Policy rollout enters phase 3 with experiential coding, regional language instruction, and smart classrooms across all states.
articles.fullContent: The Ministry of Education reported universal adoption of the new 5+3+3+4 schooling model across 28 states. Over 10,000 government model schools have received computational robotics kits.
articles.author: Meera Nair

articles.title: Tata unveils 1000km range EV battery with 10-minute charging tech
articles.summary: Solid-state battery developed in Pune R&D center enters production. New tech reduces costs by 40% and delivers ultra-fast thermal stability.
articles.fullContent: In a landmark automotive breakthrough, engineers at Tata's Pune advanced technology facility demonstrated an operational solid-state silicon-anode battery pack.
articles.author: Aditya Roy

articles.title: UPI expands to 15 countries: Japan, South Korea latest to adopt
articles.summary: NPCI signs MoU for cross-border payments with zero transaction fees. Indian tourists can now pay seamlessly using standard QR codes across Tokyo and Seoul.
articles.fullContent: NPCI International Payments Ltd (NIPL) solidified historic payment integration pacts with major banking consortiums in Tokyo and Seoul.
articles.author: Tanvi Saxena

articles.title: India tops Asian Games 2026 medal tally with 112 medals in Aichi
articles.summary: Athletics and shooting teams deliver record 38 gold medals for India. Young athletes under 21 contribute 60% of podium finishes.
articles.fullContent: The Indian contingent scripted history at the 20th Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, finishing in top positions with an unprecedented haul of 112 total medals, including 38 Gold, 42 Silver, and 32 Bronze.
articles.author: Sunil Gavaskar Jr.

articles.title: IPL 2027 mega auction: Rishabh Pant breaks record at Rs 32 crore
articles.summary: Mumbai Indians sign India captain in historic bid at Dubai venue. Total spending crosses Rs 1200 crore as two new franchises enter bidding war.
articles.fullContent: The IPL 2027 Player Mega Auction in Dubai saw all previous bidding benchmarks obliterated as dynamic wicketkeeper-batter Rishabh Pant was picked up for a record-shattering ₹32 crore.
articles.author: Ketan Trivedi

articles.title: PV Sindhu wins World Championship Gold after dominant final
articles.summary: Indian shuttler defeats world no.1 in straight sets to claim third title. Victory marks successful comeback after 18-month tactical training in Hyderabad.
articles.fullContent: Double Olympic medalist PV Sindhu produced a masterclass performance to triumph in the BWF World Championship final in Copenhagen. Defeating her opponent 21-14, 21-16 with precision smashes.
articles.author: Aparna Popat

articles.title: ISL season kickoff: Mumbai City FC vs Bengaluru FC tonight
articles.summary: League introduces VAR and AI-powered analytics for 2026-27 season. Record 14 teams participate with 3 new promoted clubs from I-League.
articles.fullContent: The Indian Super League 2026-27 campaign officially kicks off with high-voltage clash at the Mumbai Football Arena between Mumbai City FC and Bengaluru FC.
articles.author: Carlton Chapman

articles.title: Indian hockey teams qualify for Pro League finals 2026
articles.summary: Both men's and women's squads reach final four after strong European tour. India to host knockout stage in Bhubaneswar next month.
articles.fullContent: In a stellar display of modern fast-paced turf hockey, both the Indian Men's and Women's national squads locked in their spots for the FIH Pro League Grand Finals.
articles.author: Dilip Tirkey
